people.imagined: In the worm shed at the reel, judging the year's bolts. The nail of her left thumb is worn away to a smooth pink. She holds up one thread to the light and decides a grade she will lie about.
people.subject: The moment: in a worm shed, she holds a single pale silk thread up between finger and thumb against the light, checking its draw, with a veiled look. Face, most important: the left thumb, held up in front, has no nail at all, worn away to a smooth shiny pink pad, and the silk thread is stretched taut from it. A narrow, composed, sallow face of about forty; pale skin; long-lidded dark eyes; thin neat brows; a thin straight nose; a small closed mouth with a hint of secrecy. Hair: black, in a tight low knot held with a bone pin. Body: slight, upright, still. Clothing: a fine undyed silk robe, pale cream and clean, with a crossed collar and narrow sleeves tied back with silk cord at the wrist; a grey-green sash for an inner disciple; a small bamboo reel hangs at the chest. Hands: the taut thread between the left thumb and forefinger, the right hand loosely holding a bamboo reel handle. Background: blurred rows of trays and a hanging pale hank of silk, steam. Light: soft warm light from a paper window at the upper left. Qi: a faint green-gold haze in the steam. The bare left thumb is a smooth shiny pink pad with a faint ridge where the nail was, the right hand's nails are neatly trimmed, and the reel hanging at her chest is a small bamboo wheel with a worn red cord; the hanks of silk behind her glow pale and the steam softens the edges of everything. Expression: a veiled, reserved face with lowered lids and lips pressed closed, eyes slow and unrevealing.

people.imagined: He turns his wrists to show his cuffs, which are fire-silk a rank above his own, to the viewer as if by accident. He is pricing the season in his head.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a loom bench, he turns both wrists outward to display his cuffs to the viewer, smiling as if by accident, pricing the season in his head. Face: most important, his cuffs of glossy ember-red fire-silk, visibly richer than the plain cream sleeves they sit on, turned out toward the viewer. It is a handsome, smooth, shrewd face of about thirty-five, light brown in skin, with sharp dark eyes, neat arched brows, a straight nose and a half-smile. Hair: black, oiled and tied in a neat topknot with a red silk cord. Body: medium height, well groomed, a little vain in his posture. Clothing: a fine undyed silk robe, clean and pressed, a grey-green inner-disciple sash with a small jade bead the size of a pea, and the red fire-silk cuffs a rank above his own. Hands and objects: both wrists turned out, fingers spread, the cuffs shimmering as if lit from within with a woven pattern of tiny flames, a faint warm orange glow on the cloth while the cream sleeves beneath are matte. Background: blurred looms with pale silk and a thread-lit red hearth. Light: warm hearth light from the lower left, orange sparks falling onto the wooden loom frames behind him. Expression: ambitious and pragmatic, a smooth, greedy composure, the look of a man who is counting what the cuffs will fetch.

people.imagined: A lake girl stretches silk on a banner frame, unseen and forgettable; the boys forget her name by tomorrow. She has seen the draft of the great banner and keeps it behind her calm smile.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a banner frame, pulling a sheet of white silk taut, she glances up with a small content smile; she has seen the draft of the great banner and keeps it behind her calm face. Face: most important, an ordinary round, pleasant face that is easily forgotten, with a short bamboo tension pin held between her teeth. She is sixteen, light brown in skin, with soft grey-brown eyes, plain level brows, a small nose and a friendly mouth around the pin. Hair: dark brown, in two plain braids pinned up on top of her head. Body: small, sturdy and slightly rounded, with stubby fingers pink from tugging the silk. Clothing: a fine undyed silk jacket, clean and new, with narrow sleeves tucked up with cords, a pinned apron, and an outer-gate pale beige sash tied in a plain bow. Hands and objects: both hands grip the edge of a bamboo frame with white silk stretched over it, so fine that the window light shows through it like milk. Background: tall bare bamboo frames, a window. Light: soft daylight from the upper left, and a faint green-teal haze of qi in the air above the silk. Expression: a small, pleasant, forgettable smile with soft eyes and a smooth, unreadable brow.

people.imagined: He bends over a worm tray with his ear pressed to it, listening for a worm that has stopped spinning, and has already chosen the one to drop in the pit.
people.subject: The moment: bent sideways with his right ear pressed against the rim of a tray, he listens in silence, eyes half closed, about to make a hard choice. Face, most important: one ear pressed flat to a tray of silkworms, and a pair of thin steel tweezers held in his hand, poised. A long, calm, pale face of twenty-five; light skin; hooded grey eyes; thin brows; a long nose; a mouth set neutral and cold. Hair: dark brown, cropped close, with a loose strand. Body: tall, narrow, stooped. Clothing: a fine undyed silk robe of clean cream with narrow sleeves; the grey-green inner-disciple sash; a pale mulberry-leaf green apron. Hands: tweezers raised in the right hand, the left holding the tray edge. Background: blurred rows of trays with mulberry leaves, a dim shed. Light: low warm lamplight from the left. Qi: a faint pale green. The tweezers are thin steel with a bright tip, his ear is flattened against the cool wooden rim of the tray, and the silkworms in it are pale and soft, chewing with a faint rustling sound; the lamplight leaves a sharp bright line on his cheekbone and throws his eye sockets into shadow. Expression: half-closed eyes and a calm, still mouth, the face devoid of sorrow as he listens.

people.imagined: At the market table, counting bolts in a clerk's whisper, losing count on purpose, his lips moving. He thinks of his mother in Tang Âm.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a market table, he counts in a whisper with moving lips, a finger lightly tapping bolts of silk, eyes down, trusting and a little furtive, losing count on purpose while he thinks of his mother. Face: most important, lips shaped around whispered numbers, and a stack of rolled silk bolts, each tied with a different coloured cord, piled in the lower frame in front of him. It is a plain, open, boyish face of twenty-four, olive-skinned, with brown anxious eyes, thick uneven brows, a wide nose and a hopeful half-smile. Hair: black and short, a cap of brown cloth pushed back and sitting crooked. Body: medium height and narrow-shouldered. Clothing: a clean undyed silk robe of pale cloth with a loader's rope sash, the narrow sleeves rolled to the elbow, and a small brass tally bead on a thong at the collar. Hands and objects: a finger resting on a bolt; the bolts are tied with cords of red, blue, yellow and green and stacked three high. Background: blurred market awnings striping the sunlight in pale blue and white, and stacked bolts. Light: bright daylight from the upper left, with a faint brown-orange earth tint in the air. Expression: trusting and diligent, a little guilty, the unguarded worry of a boy who is not as honest as he looks.

people.imagined: She has just set a sleeve alight 'by accident' in the charring room, and looks at her own right hand's burn-shiny fingertips with satisfaction, counting seasons.
people.subject: The moment: in the charring room she looks calmly at her own raised right hand with a small honest smile, as a rival's cry fades behind her; she has just set a sleeve alight by accident and is counting seasons. Face: most important, the fingertips of her right hand only are burn-shiny, smooth and glossy as polished horn and a little darker than the rest of the hand, held up before her face, while the left hand is ordinary. It is a sharp, pretty, ambitious face of nineteen, light olive in skin, with dark amber eyes holding a bright glint, arched brows, a small straight nose and a smile with a cruel curl. Hair: dark chestnut, in a high twist pinned by a red lacquer shuttle as long as a chopstick. Body: slim, quick and poised. Clothing: a fine undyed silk robe of clean cream with a grey-green sash, the hem of one sleeve scorched brown and curled along a neat line. Hands and objects: the right hand raised with the glossy fingertips toward the viewer, a faint orange-red warmth around them. Background: a dim room with a haze of blue smoke drifting, an orange hearth glow. Light: orange hearth light from the lower left, shifting across her cheek. Expression: ambitious and honest, a quietly cruel satisfaction in the eyes and the small curve of the mouth.

people.imagined: A vat-stirrer at night copying a mordant by lamp, stained faintly blue to the hairline. She knows she will undercut the old dyer's grandchildren at the stalls.
people.subject: The moment: at night by a single lamp she bends over a small vat with a stirring paddle, copying a recipe from memory, eyes lifted guardedly at the viewer; she knows she will undercut the old dyer's grandchildren at the stalls. Face: most important, her whole skin is faintly blue-tinged from the hairline down the face and neck, as if the vats had marked her, deepest at the hairline and under the nails and fading to a faint violet on the cheeks. It is a narrow, still face of twenty-seven with small dark eyes, thin straight brows, a thin nose and closed lips. Hair: black, in a plain wrap of undyed cloth tied at the nape, a loose wisp blue at the temple. Body: small, wiry and bent over the work. Clothing: a clean, indigo-spotted linen jacket of good cloth with the sleeves rolled up and a heavy leather apron, the forearms blue to the elbow. Hands and objects: the long wooden paddle, dark with dye, stirring a vat whose surface shines like blue-black ink, a faint blue water shimmer rising from it. Background: a dark dye shed with indigo cloths hanging in long folds of different depths, from sky to midnight. Light: a yellow lamp from the lower left, deep blue shadow. Expression: patient and reclusive, a closed, faithless composure, a look that gives nothing to the viewer.

people.imagined: A tall quick woman standing at her loom, a red shuttle stuck through her hair like a pin, burn-pale fingertips flexing. She is imagining a banner that will outlast the palace's.
people.subject: The moment: a tall woman at a great loom looks up impatiently, a red shuttle stuck through her hair, burn-pale fingertips flexing at her chest as she imagines a banner that will outlast the palace's. Face: most important, a long red lacquered shuttle thrust through the knot of her hair like a hairpin, lacquered a deep cinnabar red with a brass tip. It is a sharp, strong, quick face of about forty-five, light brown in skin, with dark intense eyes, thick straight brows, a high-bridged nose and a hard thin mouth. Hair: black with streaks of grey, wound in a high knot with the red shuttle. Body: tall, straight and restless. Clothing: a fine undyed cream silk robe with a crossed collar and wide sleeves tied back with scarlet silk cord, a founder's deep scarlet sash, and a small fire-silk panel at the cuff glowing a dull ember as if breathing. Hands and objects: both hands raised at her chest with the fingers flexing, the fingertips pale, smooth and almost glassy with old scar; a faint red-gold warmth lies in the silk. Background: a great loom behind her strung with hundreds of fine taut threads that catch the light like rain, blurred. Light: strong warm window light from the upper left, with orange sparks at the loom. Expression: ambitious and impatient, a hard, callous eagerness in the mouth, the face of a woman who has already decided what the others will weave.

people.imagined: The guest dyer in the dye yard at morning, with blue hands lifted from a vat, smelling of indigo, wanting only one more year of indigo for her town's children.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a dye vat in a yard at morning, an old guest dyer lifts both blue hands dripping from the liquid and looks calmly at the viewer, wanting only one more year of indigo for her town's children. Face: most important, both hands and forearms dyed deep blue to the wrist, raised and dripping, the blue strong around the nails and knuckles and rising up the arms to the elbow in an uneven line. It is an old, lined, serene face of about seventy-five, brown and wrinkled, with clear pale grey-blue eyes, white eyebrows, a hooked nose and a small calm mouth. Hair: white, in a low bun wrapped in an indigo cloth. Body: small, bent slightly and steady. Clothing: a clean indigo-dyed linen robe in several shades from pale to deep blue with wide sleeves pushed up, a heavy pale apron, and a small polished blue stone the size of a quail's egg on a cord at the neck. Hands and objects: both hands raised, wet and blue, drips falling back into the vat with small rings; a faint blue water shimmer in the air. Background: a blurred yard of hanging indigo cloths of every shade moving in the breeze, a whole sky of blues. Light: bright clear morning light from the upper left. Expression: calm and reclusive, a quiet, settled contentment of a woman who has made peace with her own colour.

people.imagined: A small careful woman in the worm shed carries silkworms in her sleeve to keep them warm. She holds the sleeve open and looks into it before she looks at you.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a warm worm shed, she cups her opened sleeve in front of her and looks tenderly into it before looking up. Face, most important: her wide sleeve held open, showing a nest of small pale silkworms moving in the folds, and a calm, careful face. Age about sixty; small round lined face; brown skin; kind sharp dark eyes; thin grey brows; a small nose; a prim mouth. Hair: grey, in a tight low bun with a bamboo pin. Body: small, round-shouldered, still. Clothing: a fine undyed silk robe of cream, clean and mended, with a high collar and long sleeves; an elder's grey-green silk sash with a thin red edge; a small bamboo tray on a cord. Hands: one hand holds the open sleeve, the other covers it protectively. Background: blurred trays of mulberry leaves and a warm lamp. Light: warm lamp light from the lower left. Qi: a faint pale green. The silkworms in her sleeve are as small as rice grains, pale and wriggling, and she lowers her face over them so her breath warms them; the bamboo tray on its cord at her chest holds three mulberry leaves, and the lamp glow is orange against the green-grey sash with its thin red edge. Expression: a tender, careful look with lowered eyes and a soft, hushed smile.

people.imagined: At the market table haggling, twisting a too-small ring on his finger. He has just lost again to the palace's factor and is already planning to take his tenth.
people.subject: The moment: haggling across a table, he twists a ring on one finger with the thumb of the same hand, smiling falsely, while the other hand is raised in a bargaining gesture. Face, most important: a ring on every finger, ten rings glinting, and the smallest one visibly too tight, pinching the finger. A florid, round, sleek face of about forty-two; ruddy skin; shrewd small black eyes; thin neat moustache; a snub nose; a wide, smiling mouth. Hair: black, oiled and combed, with a small gold cap pin. Body: stout, with a round belly, expansive in gesture. Clothing: a fine undyed silk robe with a rich dark-red waistcoat over it, a factor's green sash, a small abacus-shaped brass charm at the collar. Hands: both hands in front, rings glittering. Background: a blurred market with awnings and stacked silk. Light: bright market light from the upper left. Qi: a faint metallic gleam on the rings. The ten rings are of jade, gold, silver and plain iron, one with a red stone, and the smallest on his right little finger is sunk into the flesh so the skin bulges around it; the dark red waistcoat shines with silk, the abacus charm swings, and bolts of silk in bright colours are heaped on the table. Expression: a false, bright smile with eyes that stay hard and watchful, a muscle tight at the jaw.

people.imagined: The embroiderer looks first at the viewer's hands, before the face, with a needle silver at her lapel, weighing them. She dislikes a thread colour and decides.
people.subject: The moment: seated at an embroidery frame, she looks first at the viewer's hands, her gaze lowered and critical, a silver needle through her lapel. Face, most important: a long silver needle pinned through the lapel of her robe, glinting at the chest, and eyes cast down and sideways in appraisal. A fine, cool, pale face of forty; porcelain skin; narrow dark eyes; arched thin brows; a long straight nose; thin lips in a pinched line. Hair: black, in a very neat chignon with a single silver comb. Body: slim, erect, elegant. Clothing: a fine undyed silk robe of cream with an indigo-dyed collar and cuffs in a delicate shade, a pale rose sash; the silver needle in the lapel. Hands: one hand holds an embroidery hoop with a half-worked cloud-pattern of coloured thread. Background: blurred banners of coloured silk without writing, a window. Light: cool north light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green-gold haze. The silver needle in her lapel is long and fine with a tiny bead head and a thread of rose silk trailing from it; her indigo collar is an even deep blue, her hands are pale and slender with spotless nails, and the embroidery hoop shows clouds in three shades of pink and gold on cream. Expression: a cool, critical gaze with lowered lids, one brow arched and a thin, superior mouth.

people.imagined: She has just set the fire in a best bolt and singed her own eyebrow again, and wants to try a vent. She grins before the smoke clears.
people.subject: The moment: in a haze of smoke she grins eagerly with a pleased, flushed face, having just lit a thread; she has set fire to a best bolt and singed her own eyebrow again, and wants to try a vent. Face: most important, her left eyebrow is singed down to short charred stubble while the right is full and dark, clearly uneven, and a soot smudge shaped like a thumb marks her cheek. It is a round, bold, rosy face of twenty-two, warm brown in skin, with bright dark eyes, a bold nose and a wide grin. Hair: dark brown, pinned with a red lacquer shuttle, a front curl scorched brown at the tip. Body: sturdy and vigorous, leaning in toward the flame. Clothing: a fine undyed cream silk robe, its cuffs scorched at the edge by her work, a deep-red fire-setter's sash, and a blackened leather glove on the left hand. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a small clay lamp with a bright yellow flame; a faint red-orange glow at the fingers. Background: a blurred charring room with an orange glow and drifting smoke. Light: orange firelight from the lower left. Expression: delighted and brave, impatient, an ambitious grin that comes before the smoke has cleared.

people.imagined: She feeds the worms and names them; she has just come away from the pit with wet eyes and a thread tied around her wrist bearing a cocoon's name.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a pit with a basket of mulberry leaves, she wipes her wet eyes with the back of a wrist and looks up with a trembling smile. Face, most important: a fine thread tied around her wrist with a tiny cocoon knotted into it, held up near her cheek, and wet, red-rimmed eyes. A small, soft, round face of twenty; pale pink skin; big dark brown eyes shining with tears; thin brows; a button nose; a wavering mouth. Hair: black, in two short braids with green yarn. Body: small, slight, hunched. Clothing: a clean undyed silk jacket of cream with a woven grass-green apron; the outer-gate pale sash; sleeves a little long. Hands: one hand holds the basket of leaves, the other wipes her eye. Background: blurred shed trays and a dark pit edge. Light: soft diffused light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green glimmer on the leaves. The thread on her wrist is pale green with a tiny cocoon knotted in it, and her sleeve is damp where she has wiped her eyes; the basket on her arm is half full of fresh mulberry leaves, and behind her the edge of the pit is dark and shadowed, with the pale shapes of silk trays stacked in the soft light. Expression: wet, reddened eyes and a trembling smile, the lower lip unsteady and the cheeks damp.

people.imagined: After the lamps are out he reels extra cocoons at the pot, drawing a thread a mile long. His fingertips are boiled smooth. He does not know how well he draws.
people.subject: The moment: late at night over a steaming pot he draws a fine silk thread from a cocoon with perfect steadiness, looking up calm and a little tired; after the lamps are out he reels extra cocoons, and does not know how well he draws. Face: most important, his fingertips are boiled completely smooth, with no prints at all, glossy and pink like polished shells, held in the steam, and a single unbroken thread rising from them, so fine it is only a glint. It is a plain, honest, steady face of twenty-four, fair and flushed by steam, with light brown eyes, straight brows, a straight nose and a closed, gentle mouth. Hair: dark brown, tied in a small knot, damp with steam. Body: lean and patient, precise in posture. Clothing: a clean undyed cream silk robe with the sleeves tied back with cord, and a grey-green inner-disciple sash. Hands and objects: the thread drawn between the fingertips above a squat iron pot with a bamboo lid; steam clings to his hair and eyelashes, and a faint green-gold shimmer lies in it. Background: a dark shed lit by a single small lamp, which makes a warm gold spot on the wall. Light: soft warm lamp glow from the lower left. Expression: diligent and calm, honest, the steady, unhurried attention of a man for whom the thread is the only thing in the room.

people.imagined: A fisher girl who threads needles faster than anyone, with a fish-scale glitter on her cheek she swears is not paint, giggling at the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a table, she threads a needle in one quick motion and grins at the viewer, delighted with herself. Face, most important: a patch of glittering fish-scale shimmer on her left cheekbone, silver and blue, plainly visible, and a threaded needle held up. A round, quick, bright face of sixteen; tanned skin; sparkling dark eyes; thin arched brows; a small round nose; a wide grin. Hair: black, in a loose braid with a blue thread woven through. Body: small, quick, bouncy. Clothing: a fine undyed silk jacket of cream with a pale blue collar, narrow sleeves tied with thread; an outer-gate beige sash. Hands: a long needle held up in the right hand, a thread through its eye. Background: blurred embroidery frames and colourful silk without writing. Light: bright daylight from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue shimmer on the cheek. The fish-scale glitter is a scatter of tiny silver-blue flecks like spilled sequins over the left cheekbone, the blue thread in her braid is bright as a kingfisher, and the needle in her fingers is long and silver with the thread threaded; the embroidery frames behind her are splashes of coral, jade and saffron. Expression: a delighted, gleeful grin with sparkling eyes and a scrunched nose, fish-scale glitter on one cheek.

people.imagined: An old leaf-picker whistles through a gap in her teeth under a mulberry row. She has left the high rows unpicked and carries gossip. She is content and does not hurry.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a mulberry row, an old leaf-picker whistles cheerfully through a gap in her teeth, a big basket on her back; she has left the high rows unpicked and carries gossip, and she does not hurry. Face: most important, a gap where the left front tooth was, a dark notch in her pursed whistling mouth, under a wide woven conical hat with a broad brim. She appears about seventy, with brown, sun-leathered skin creased by a thousand wrinkles, bright small black eyes, thin white eyebrows, a flat broad nose and a puckered mouth. Hair: thin white, tied in a bun under the hat. Body: short, strong and bent slightly. Clothing: a clean, sturdy undyed hemp jacket, a wide dark blue skirt, a leaf-green apron and a cloth belt; the sun-bleached conical hat has a chin cord of twisted straw. Hands and objects: both hands hold the straps of a basket piled with glossy green mulberry leaves; a faint brown-gold earth tint hangs in the air. Background: green mulberry rows running away in lines, sunlit leaves. Light: dappled bright daylight from the upper left, moving on her wrinkled cheeks. Expression: content and amused, lazy and forgiving, the easy, pleased pucker of a woman at peace with her work.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the weaver who tried first, at the age her hands burned to the bone: she looks stubbornly forward, her wrapped hands held in front of her.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded like old silk, of a weaver holding her heavily bandaged hands up before her, looking forward with a stubborn, steady gaze. Face, most important: both hands wrapped to the wrist in layered pale silk bandages stained faintly brown, held up in front. A lean, strong face of about fifty; brown skin with deep lines; fierce dark eyes; thick straight brows; a firm nose; a set mouth. Hair: black with grey, pulled back and tied in a plain knot. Body: lean, straight-backed. Clothing: a clean old undyed silk robe of cream with plain sleeves and a faded red sash. Background: the dim shape of a loom with a single glowing red thread, a muted dark wall. Light: soft pale glow from the upper left; the whole picture faded, soft-edged and yellowed like old silk. Qi: a faint ember-red wash around the hands. The bandaged hands are bound in layers of silk gone brown with stains, the fingers stiff and thick inside like paddles, and a few threads of faded red escape from the wrapping; the loom behind her is dim, and one red thread glows at its centre like a small ember; the whole is faded, soft and yellow like old silk. Expression: a stubborn, steady gaze with a firm, closed mouth and a lifted chin, faded like old silk.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the master reeler of a burned town, at the age she barred the road with her reelers: calm, hands folded, a reel at her side.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded like old silk, of the master reeler of a burned town at the age she barred the road with her reelers, standing at a doorway with her hands folded, calm and unyielding. Face: most important, a small bamboo reel held against her chest in both hands, and a straight, steady face. She is about fifty, with a strong square face, weathered brown skin, deep-set steady dark eyes, thick grey eyebrows, a broad nose and a firm mouth. Hair: grey, in a neat tight bun with a bamboo pin. Body: solid and upright. Clothing: a plain undyed silk robe of cream with a high collar mended in careful stitches, the sleeves tied back, a reeler's pale apron, and a plain cord sash. Hands and objects: the folded hands broad with reeler's calluses around the bamboo reel, worn pale and smooth, with a crank handle. Background: a dim doorway and a faint orange glow behind it, the distant burning town. Light: a soft pale glow from the upper left; the whole picture faded, soft-edged and yellowed like an old silk painting, with the edges darkened and a faint orange wash at the borders. Expression: stubborn and brave, loyal, the level, unmoving look of a woman who has decided where the road ends.
